component.name: Harmonic Explorer
component.summary: Explore harmonics, dissonance and chords on a guitar fretboard

description.p: Harmonic Explorer is an interactive tool for understanding why notes sound consonant or dissonant together, seen through the lens of a guitar fretboard.

ul.li: Clickable guitar fretboard with capo and key selection
Additive synthesis with selectable waveforms and an ADSR envelope editor
Live Plomp–Levelt dissonance curve for the selected notes
Chord builder with consonance/dissonance analysis of every interval
Melody playback in the selected key

description.p: Everything runs offline; the application makes no network connections.
First packaged release, based on the v2 prototype.
